dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us6000smgy](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us6000smgy) Magnitude 5.9 earthquake at 48.684 depth occurred on Apr 04 2026 111 km ESE of Bitung, Indonesia. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude 1.1109 longitude 126.0732. It impacted 1836 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
